question: What claim is made about the yoginī named Icchā with respect to agency and extent?
premises: She is associated with the siddhas.
By supreme will she extends up to the end of Māyā.
inference: The yoginī named Icchā, by supreme will and in association with the siddhas, extends up to the end of Māyā.
uncertainties: The precise relation to the siddhas is not detailed here.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by supreme will, extends up to the end of Māyā through the siddhas.
